authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 444 verifies the whole Hindi candr-mā/candar-mā moon compound. The Hindi survey candrama attestation (kannauji p. 64) is linked to Sanskrit candramas in this same validated batch and provides a provisional immediate regional donor for the other survey forms. Independent Sanskrit learning or another Indo-Aryan intermediary remains possible; the attestation locality is not asserted to be the historical source. Exact source form cāndramā is retained.
